description: Erection of rear roof dormer and rear outrigger second floor roof extensions, installation of two side roof lights and matching double glazed replacement of existing first floor rear and two storey rear outrigger first floor side windows to the house and installation of one front roof light.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  2021-88WA-LF-1; 2021-88WA-LF-2; 2021-88WA-LF-3; 2021-88WA-LF-4; 2021-88WA-LF-5; 2021-88WA-LF-6  Received:  19 May 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The side window to be installed within the house's two storey rear outrigger second floor roof extension and the two roof lights to be installed within the house's two storey rear outrigger side roof plane hereby approved shall be obscure glazed only and be permanently retained as such.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the flank elevation of the development hereby permitted.
